rule: ELV6 captures exact physical evidence; ELV7 decides jurisdictional applicability and compliance. No numeric threshold from an external standard becomes an ELV6 kernel constant unless it is an intrinsic adopted product capability.

kazakhstanStatusNotes: KSM lists GOST IEC 61439-1-2013 and GOST IEC 61439-2-2015 as current national-use standards.
KSM lists GOST IEC 61439-1-2024 and GOST IEC 61439-2-2024 as adopted by the interstate council but not yet introduced; they must not silently replace the current KZ profile.
KSM lists ST RK IEC 60529-2012, ST RK IEC 62262-2012, ST RK IEC 60364-5-54-2012 and ST RK IEC 60297-3-100-2018 as current.
